title: Evaluating transfer across modalities in autonomous materials systems
description: Figure scripts, result files, producing code and inputs for the paper "Evaluating transfer across modalities in autonomous materials systems" (Digital Discovery (RSC)). Taylor D. notes: Code (Python, shell and SLURM scripts) is released under the MIT License (LICENSE). Data, result files and figures are released under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International licence (LICENSE-CC-BY-4.0.txt).
